title: What is the average number of single bonds per atom in non-carcinogenic mol
question: What is the average number of single bonds per atom in non-carcinogenic molecules that do not contain sulfur?

prediction.sql:
SELECT AVG(bond_count) AS average_single_bonds_per_atom
FROM (
  SELECT a."XCL_001", COUNT(b."XCL_004") AS bond_count
  FROM atom AS a
  INNER JOIN molecule AS m ON a."XCL_002" = m."XCL_010"
  INNER JOIN bond AS b ON a."XCL_002" = b."XCL_005"
  WHERE m."XCL_011" = '-'
    AND b."XCL_006" = '-'
    AND a."XCL_002" NOT IN (
      SELECT a2."XCL_002"
      FROM atom AS a2
      WHERE a2."XCL_003" = 's'
    )
  GROUP BY a."XCL_001"
) AS per_atom_counts

SELECT AVG(bond_count) AS average_single_bonds_per_atom
FROM (
  SELECT a."XCL_001", COUNT(b."XCL_004") AS bond_count
  FROM atom AS a
  INNER JOIN molecule AS m ON a."XCL_002" = m."XCL_010"
  INNER JOIN bond AS b ON a."XCL_002" = b."XCL_005"
  WHERE m."XCL_011" = '-'
    AND b."XCL_006" = '-'
